day0_welcome.title: Crypted Signal
day0_welcome.step0_dialogue:
You arrive at HoakHaven — a ramshackle village built around a massive, flickering energy spire. The air hums with fading power. A small robot rolls up, antenna twitching.

*GambleBot:* "BEEP BOOP! A new arrival! Name's GambleBot — I run the Casino. Normally I'd sell you a ticket, but... see that tower? That's the **Zenith Generator**. It's been dying for years. When it goes, no more power for mining, farming, or gaming. This whole village goes dark."

He leans closer, voice dropping.

*GambleBot:* "You wouldn't happen to have received a strange transmission... would you? A distress signal? Because honestly, we sent it out decades ago and nobody ever showed up. Until you."
day0_welcome.step1_activity: Goal: The Generator still produces enough to give every villager a small daily stipend. Use `!daily` to claim yours and get started.
day0_welcome.step2_dialogue:
*GambleBot:* "Here — take this **Old Journal**. It belonged to the Council of Four, the founders who built this village after the Collapse. It mentions something called the **Strata Blueprints** — the original schematics for the Generator. They were lost centuries ago. If we could find them..."

He points toward the forge.

*GambleBot:* "**Thorek** at the smithy knows the mines better than anyone. Show him the journal. Tell him GambleBot sent you."

day1_strata.title: Day 1: Forged in Fire
day1_strata.step0_dialogue:
Thorek — a stout, soot-covered blacksmith — squints at the journal you hand him.

*Thorek:* "By the Anvil... this is Merrik's handwriting. Merrik was the Council's chief engineer. See here — he mentions 'Strata Blueprints' and 'Vault Level 7.' If those coordinates are right, the blueprints might still be in the deepest mineshaft!"

He tosses you a pickaxe.

*Thorek:* "I've been trying to reach them for years, but the tunnels are unstable. A fresh pair of hands might make the difference. Here's how mining works: every time you dig deeper with `!mine`, you risk a cave-in. If the gallery collapses, you lose everything you've gathered. Know when to walk away."
day1_strata.step1_activity: Goal: Use `!mine` 10 times to gather resources and reinforce the tunnels.
day1_strata.step2_dialogue:
After inspecting your haul, Thorek grins.

*Thorek:* "Not bad! You've got grit, newcomer. Your digging produced enough data to triangulate the Vault's location. I've forged the coordinates into this map fragment."

He taps a glowing point on the map.

*Thorek:* "The Vault is sealed with an **Alchemical Lock** — some kind of pre-Collapse biotech. Only **Elara** in the community garden can crack that. Go see her — she's a bit of a plant whisperer. Tell her I sent you."

day2_alchemy.title: Day 2: Living Keys
day2_alchemy.step0_dialogue:
Elara — surrounded by hovering botanical drones and glowing saplings — examines the map fragment.

*Elara:* "An Alchemical Lock! I've read about these in the old horticulture archives. The Ancients used living biological keys — rare plants whose growth patterns encode unlock sequences. If the Lock is still functioning, we'll need to grow the right combination of crops."

She smiles.

*Elara:* "This isn't just farming, friend — it's cracking a centuries-old security system. Use `!farm` to plant crops. Match your seeds to your lands: Public Fields work for basics, but you'll need better plots for rare seeds. The Lock requires **Wheat** for the base sequence."

A pause. Her expression shifts.

*Elara:* "There's something you should know. The Generator wasn't just a power source. It was built above a **Vault**. The Ancients sealed something inside — something they were afraid of."
day2_alchemy.step1_activity: Goal: Plant 10 crops using `!farm` to decode the Lock's genetic markers.
day2_alchemy.step2_choice:
The crops bloom. On your terminal, the Vault's seal partially unlocks — revealing a second data layer.

*Elara:* "It's working! But... the Lock's secondary protocol just activated. It's asking me: 'Confirm authorization to access sealed containment.' This is where it gets serious. Opening the Lock doesn't just restart the power — it might release whatever the Ancients locked away."
day2_alchemy.choice_b_label: Let's be careful. What else is there to learn?
day2_alchemy.choice_a_response:
You nod firmly. Elara matches your resolve.

*Elara:* "Straightforward. I respect that. Let's do this."
day2_alchemy.choice_b_response:
Elara considers this.

*Elara:* "Smart. There's someone you should talk to — **Irian**, our ranger. She's been tracking anomalies in the forest for months. Whatever's in that Vault... she might know more."

day3_base.title: Day 3: A Place to Call Home
day3_base.description: Setting up base and the next clue.
day3_base.step0_req:
Your comms device buzzes — a synthesized voice crackles through.

*ARIA (Automated Restoration Intelligence Assistant):* "Alert: Partial blueprint fragments decoded. To proceed, you require a stationary terminal with stable power. Recommendation: acquire a Starter Shack. Requirements: **500 credits** and **2 Iron Ore**. Thorek has prepped the materials."
day3_base.step1_activity: Goal: Visit the Real Estate Agency with `!house shop` and purchase your first home. Every operative needs a base.
day3_base.step2_dialogue:
As your house's terminal powers up, the Strata fragments begin auto-decoding. The screen flickers with a new coordinate set — deep in the forest — with a warning overlay.

*ARIA:* "Data layer 3 decoded. Location: Wilds Zone, Sector 7. WARNING: Biological containment breach detected. Native fauna may be hostile. Recommendation: acquire a combat companion before proceeding."

A small icon of a paw print blinks on your map display.

day4_will.title: Day 4: Taming the Wild
day4_will.description: Hunting, pets, and the full blueprint.
day4_will.step0_dialogue:
A tall figure leans against your doorway — Irian, the village ranger. She looks weathered, competent, and slightly amused.

*Irian:* "So you're the one Thorek and Elara won't shut up about. Good. You'll need that kind of reputation for what's in the Wilds."

She pulls up a holographic tracker display.

*Irian:* "I've been monitoring anomalies in the forest for months. Creatures that don't match any known species — pre-Collapse genetic experiments that survived. The blueprint says Vault access requires a biological imprint from local fauna. Translation: we go `!hunt`. Your pet fights wild monsters. Keep an eye on its HP — a K.O.'d pet gets nothing. Start with the Forest, it's safest."
day4_will.step1_activity: Goal: Hunt 10 times using `!hunt` to collect Ancient DNA signatures.
day4_will.step2_dialogue:
After your tenth hunt, your pet drags something from the undergrowth — a sleek, pulsing egg covered in ancient biotech seals.

*Irian:* "Well. That's not supposed to exist. This is a **Mystery Egg** from the Ancients' gene labs. The creatures inside were never finished — they're genetic recombinations. Could be anything from a house cat to a dragon. Hatch it with `!hatch` when you're ready."

Your terminal chimes. The full blueprint assembles on screen.

*Irian (grinning):* "The Vault access point is... of course it is... directly beneath **GambleBot's Casino**."

*Irian laughs.* "The Ancients hid the apocalypse under a casino. Because why make it easy?"

day5_odds.title: Day 5: The House Always Wins
day5_odds.step0_dialogue:
GambleBot is practically vibrating with excitement.

*GambleBot:* "BEEP. BOOP. You are NOT going to believe this — I've been sitting on top of the Strata Vault for THREE HUNDRED YEARS and never knew it! The Casino wasn't built for entertainment — it was built to generate **probabilistic energy**. Every coin flip, every slot pull, every blackjack hand — the randomness feeds the Generator. It's the final key to the Vault!"

He gestures at the casino floor.

*GambleBot:* "Here's the beautiful part — the Vault requires a specific energy signature that only high-volume gambling produces. The Ancients literally built a lock that opens when people get lucky. Play any casino game 5 times — Coinflip, Slots, Blackjack, Roulette. I'll monitor the readings."
day5_odds.step1_activity: Goal: Play 5 Casino mini-games to generate enough probabilistic energy.
day5_odds.step2_dialogue:
The casino floor rumbles. Beneath your feet, ancient machinery groans awake. The slot machines briefly display the same message in unison: "STANDBY MODE DEACTIVATED."

A holographic face shimmers in the center of the casino — angular, feminine, flickering with static.

*Zenith OS:* "Authorization query detected. This unit has been dormant for 4,732 cycles. Initiating integrity check..."

*GambleBot:* "Uh. Nobody told me there was a GHOST in the basement."

*Zenith OS:* "Processing... ERROR. Community infrastructure rating: INSUFFICIENT. The Grand Market, Guild Bank, and Great Statue must reach minimum operational thresholds before Vault access is granted. The Ancients decreed: a society that does not invest in itself does not deserve their legacy."

The hologram dissolves.

day6_contribution.title: Day 6: Together We Stand
day6_contribution.description: Community investment and the AI's final test.
day6_contribution.step0_dialogue:
All four NPCs gather around the silent hologram projector.

*Thorek:* "You've GOT to be kidding me. They installed bureaucracy into their apocalypse bunker?!"

*Elara:* "Actually... think about it. The Ancients wanted to make sure whoever reopened the Vault had already rebuilt a functioning community. It's a failsafe against raiders and looters."

*Irian:* "Makes sense. If you can't even maintain a village, you're not qualified to handle whatever's in the Vault."

*GambleBot:* "BEEP — translation: we ALL pitch in. The community buildings need resources. Use `!community` to donate. We need **5 Iron Ore** and **5 Wheat** to prove we're serious."
day6_contribution.step1_req:
Goal: Donate 5 Iron Ore and 5 Wheat to the community buildings.

*Zenith OS flickers back, slightly more stable:* "Community threshold... approaching. WARNING: Primary Guardian unit activation delay has expired. The Guardian has entered autonomous mode. It no longer recognizes current leadership. Proceed with caution."

day7_sprout.title: Day 7: The Guardian
day7_sprout.description: Final confrontation and the world beyond.
day7_sprout.step0_event:
The Vault opens with a thunderous groan. From the darkness, a massive combat mech unit rises — angular plates of black metal, a single blue eye, weapons systems humming.

*Zenith OS (final transmission):* "The Guardian unit cannot distinguish friend from foe after extended hibernation. To access the Generator core, you must disable it. Your combat companion is the only registered biological entity — the Guardian will engage. Good luck. I am... sorry."
day7_sprout.step1_boss: Goal: Defeat the Guardian with your pet to restore the Generator!
day7_sprout.step2_dialogue_team:
The Guardian collapses, its core glowing softly instead of violently — recognizing you as authorized at the last moment. The Zenith Generator blazes to life. Across HoakHaven, every light, every machine, every forge fires up.

*Thorek:* "HAHA! THE FORGE FIRES! Look at that heat — I can smelt ANYTHING now!"

*Elara:* "The crops are glowing... the Generator's energy is nourishing the soil. I've never seen growth rates like this!"

*Irian:* "Fish are practically jumping into the boats. Whatever you just did — the ecosystem is celebrating."

*GambleBot:* "BEEP... BOOP... FULL POWER RESTORED. Casino operational at 400% efficiency. New games unlocking. You, my friend, are a legend."
day7_sprout.step3_dialogue_unknown:
The Guardian's chest panel slides open, revealing a glowing data core. A voice — calm, ancient — fills the air.

*Zenith OS:* "Threat neutralized. You have demonstrated the qualities the Ancients sought: resourcefulness, cooperation, and the willingness to gamble on uncertain outcomes."

A massive holographic map projects onto the casino ceiling — 12 glowing markers across the continent. Only HoakHaven is lit. The others pulse faintly, waiting.

*Zenith OS:* "The Vault contains data on **12 additional Generator installations** spread across the continent. Each one is a community waiting for revival. The Collapse nearly ended civilization — but the Ancients left a way to rebuild. Explore deeper. Grow rarer. Hatch stronger. Win bigger. Find the other Vaults."

The hologram fades. GambleBot spins on his wheel.

*GambleBot:* "Well! What are you waiting for? The slots are hot, the mines are deep, and the world is HUGE. Welcome to HoakHaven — **for real this time.**"

thorek.role: I refine metals and help miners. High affinity with me will grant a passive reduction to your mining risk (up to -20 risk).
thorek.advice: Mining is about managing risk. Don't dig too deep if your bag is full, or the mine will collapse on your loot!
thorek.chat: Clang! Clang! Just working on a new pickaxe prototype. Hard work builds character, lad.

elara.hint: (Likes mystery eggs, star fruits, golden apples, seeds, and berries)
elara.greeting_low: Hello. Please take care of the earth and the pets.
elara.greeting_med: Lovely to see you. My plants are growing wonderfully today.
elara.greeting_high: Hello dear! Nature itself sings in your presence.

elara.role: I help with farming and pets. High affinity with me will reduce your crops' grow time by up to 20%.

elara.chat: The sprouts are looking so green today. Make sure to feed your pets so they don't go hungry!

irian.role: I help fishers catch rare marine life. High affinity with me will extend your fishing bite reaction window.
irian.advice: Be fast! Ocean fishing has a very narrow bite window, but it's where the most legendary beasts dwell.
irian.chat: Just looking at the horizon... They say a giant Kraken roams the deep waters when the sky turns dark.
